CustomField.description: Salesforce formula returning true or false, written like a formula field of the narrative and evaluated by DisclaimerLogicalRules (FormulaEvaluatorService). Narrative fields directly or prefixed (Country__c, Narrative__c.Country__c); the selected product prefixed Product__c. or Product__r. (Product__r.LegalForm__c); lookups followed, 4 at most per path (Product__r.ParentProduct__r.LegalForm__c). With products selected, evaluated on each of them, Condition Scope saying whether at least one or all must pass. Without product, evaluated on the narrative; a condition reading the product then never passes. Empty = no condition.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula returning true or false. Selected product: ISPICKVAL(Product__r.LegalForm__c, "SICAV") (or Product__c.LegalForm__c). Narrative: its fields directly. Picklists: ISPICKVAL() or TEXT(). Empty = no condition.
CustomField.label: Condition
